race.description: Tradies Support The Ladies Pink Night At The Track Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: YACHT GIRL (9) carved out solid closing splits first up when a tidy fourth over 1200m at Scone in C3 company. Ready for the extra journey with the fast early tempo. Each-way contender. NEED A MIRACLE (6) won two-in-a-row on the country tracks, then was drawn off the course with a struggling ninth over 1350m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Back in his right grade and winning apprentice jumps back on from the low gate. SIPPING SHAMUS (5) resumed off the one trial with a plugging seventh over 1200m at Scone. Comes to hand quickly and has an excellent record over this track and trip. Genuine top three contender. OENOLOGY (4) tongue-tie comes off after he offered little when ninth over 1500m at Newcastle. Earlier runs had merit and place preferred.
